rationale: Pursuing area/resource relief. An aggressive reduction of CPU caches to '64 2 128 4' resulted in an execution failure, indicating an overshoot. Contracting around the better region by halving the L1 and L2 set counts from the baseline to '128 4 256 8' aims to safely reduce LUT and BRAM utilization without breaking execution stability.
search_intent: Moderately reduce CPU caches to lower area utilization after a bolder reduction failed.
